task.description: Design a suite-wide mitigation against service_catalog (the codebase's only global, non-tenant-scoped table) accumulating leftover rows from an interrupted/crashed mix test run -- root cause behind ISS-0409/ISS-0410 (both closed no_defect). Evaluate a test_helper.exs pre-suite check/cleanup, a mix letflow.check.test gate, and reuse of any existing orphan-cleanup convention (e.g. TenantSchemaReaper); pick the best-fitting mechanism.
acceptance_criteria: Mechanism placement is justified against both options ISS-0414 names (test_helper.exs vs. mix letflow.check.test) and against the existing TenantSchemaReaper convention, with evidence read from the actual files, not assumed
Design specifies the exact mechanism: where it runs, what it does on finding unexpected rows (warn/auto-clean/fail), and the precise algorithm

Design addresses whether service_catalog has any legitimate non-test use that the mechanism must not disturb (checked: none in the test DB; dev/prod use via the admin API is real but structurally unreachable by this mechanism per its test_helper.exs placement)
Design addresses avoiding new flakiness, specifically race conditions against scripts/test_parallel.sh's partitioning

result.summary: Wrote lib/letflow/design/iss0414-service-catalog-safety-net.md. Chosen mechanism: extend the existing test/support/tenant_schema_reaper.ex (already the established test_helper.exs pre-suite/after_suite hygiene convention, per ISS-0064/ISS-0110/ISS-0217) with a new sweep_service_catalog_orphans/1 function, reusing its existing pg_stat_activity-based concurrent-invocation guard verbatim (same-module call, no duplication) so scripts/test_parallel.sh sibling partitions are correctly excluded from triggering deferral (ISS-0217's TEST_PARALLEL_GROUP tag) while a genuinely separate concurrent mix test invocation still defers the sweep entirely rather than guessing. On finding any row at either boundary point, the design specifies: warn-log every found service_id/scope, then delete unconditionally (no age/scope filter needed -- justified in section 2.1 since, unlike tenant_schemas, no service_catalog row is ever legitimately held open across a test-process boundary). Confirmed via grep that service_catalog is never seeded and no test uses setup_all against it, and that test_helper.exs (loaded under MIX_ENV=test by every invocation shape) structurally can never reach dev/prod. Called from test_helper.exs at the same two existing boundary points as sweep_orphans/2. Also specifies a new dedicated test file (test/support/service_catalog_reaper_test.exs, coverage list in design doc section 4) and a docs/guides/test_developer_guide.md note (section 6); no docs/anti-patterns.md entry needed (section 5, reasoned). Two open questions recorded (OQ-1: same-invocation mid-run leaks remain unhealed by design, same as the tenant_schemas precedent's own OQ-1; OQ-2: whether TenantSchemaReaper should eventually be renamed now that it covers two tables -- deferred to REVIEWER, not decided here). No implementation code in the doc -- one bare @spec line only, no defmodule/function bodies. Committed 2f4e88f1 and pushed to fix/ISS-0414-service-catalog-safety-net-20260902.
result.routing: Route to Step 1b CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR to gate this design before ELIXIR-DEV implements.
